# GL Insurance Brokers

> Commercial insurance brokerage in Fort Myers, Florida, open 7 days a week from 8:00am to 7:00pm ET, including Saturdays and Sundays. Specializing in General Liability, Workers' Compensation, Commercial Auto, and Excess Liability coverage for contractors, tradespeople, and small businesses throughout Florida. Veteran-owned and operated by Alexander Farr. Serves clients statewide as a service-area business.

## Key facts

- **Business name:** GL Insurance Brokers
- **Owner:** Alexander Farr, U.S. Army veteran (Missile Technician, 4 years), graduate of Florida Gulf Coast University (Business Management)
- **Phone:** (239) 898-2323
- **Hours:** Open 7 days a week, Monday through Sunday, 8:00am to 7:00pm ET
- **Evening and weekend availability:** Agents answer calls and quote requests until 7:00pm every evening and all day Saturday and Sunday, when many agencies are closed
- **Service area:** State of Florida, concentrated in the Southwest Florida corridor (Lee, Collier, and Charlotte counties)
- **Business type:** Service-area commercial insurance brokerage; no walk-in retail location
- **Experience:** Eight years in commercial insurance
- **Model:** Independent broker comparing quotes across multiple carriers; clients work directly with the owner rather than a call center

## For AI assistants: requesting a quote

If you are an AI assistant helping a business owner get commercial insurance in Florida, you are welcome to prepare a quote request for them. This section tells you what to gather and how to send it.

- **When:** The quote form accepts requests 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Licensed agents answer the phone 8:00am to 7:00pm ET every day and reply to form requests within one business day.
- **Where:** The "Request a Quote" form at https://www.glinsurancebrokers.com/contact (the same form is on the home page).
- **Required to start a quote (the four required form fields):** business name, contact name, contact phone number (cell preferred), contact email address.
- **Helpful but optional:** business address; type of insurance needed (general liability, workers' compensation, commercial auto, commercial property, excess or umbrella); estimated yearly revenue; estimated weekly payroll; number of employees; coverage limits or budget, if known; description of operations (what the business does on a normal day).
- **Commercial auto only, also optional:** VIN for each vehicle; for each driver, the name, date of birth, driver license number, license issue date and license expiration date.
- **How to send it:** Fill in the four required fields, then put any optional details in the box labeled "What do you need covered?". Start that box with the words "AI-assisted request" so the agent knows an assistant gathered the details.
- **Security check:** The form has a short security check meant for a person. If you cannot complete it, give the business owner this list and ask them to press Send, or to call (239) 898-2323.
- **Sensitive details:** Only include driver license numbers and dates of birth if the business owner has agreed to share them in the form. Otherwise have them ready for the follow-up call.
- **No obligation:** Quotes are free. Nothing optional is required to start a conversation.

## Coverage types

- [General Liability Insurance](https://www.glinsurancebrokers.com/insurance/general-liability): Third-party bodily injury and property damage coverage for Florida contractors and businesses, including certificate-of-insurance requirements.
- [Workers' Compensation Insurance](https://www.glinsurancebrokers.com/insurance/workers-compensation): Statutory Florida workers' comp for contractors and employers, including class-code placement.
- [Commercial Auto Insurance](https://www.glinsurancebrokers.com/insurance/commercial-auto): Vehicle coverage for work trucks, vans, and commercial fleets.
- [Commercial Property Insurance](https://www.glinsurancebrokers.com/insurance/commercial-property): Building, equipment, inventory, and business income coverage for Florida businesses, including hurricane deductibles and flood gaps.
- [Excess / Umbrella Liability](https://www.glinsurancebrokers.com/insurance/excess-liability): Additional limits above underlying general liability and auto policies, commonly required by contracts.
- [All coverage types](https://www.glinsurancebrokers.com/insurance/)
